sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Energy / Thermal Coal · Indonesia. PT Karya Pacific Energy Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in trading and investment in the energy sector. The company operates through two segments: Energy and Mining. The company's Mining segment engages in coal mining and related services in Indonesia. The company's Energy segment provides special port services and contractor mining services. Additionally, the company engages in oil and gas investment and operations.
